name: deletion
operation: deleteListing (rpc delete_listing) and deleteAccount (Edge Function delete-account)
notes: Re-baselined 2026-10-07 to migrations through 20261006000021 (v2). v1 described 0001-0012.

Both are HARD deletes. Dart ProviderRepository.deleteListing is documented as 'soft-deletes' (provider_repository.dart:217) and ListingStatus.deleted exists in Dart, but SQL has no deleted status and cascades the row away (docs/backend-contract.md 4.6).

deleteAccount removes auth.users and cascades public rows; reports keep a provider_snapshot with provider_id set null (20261006000019_retention.sql), and storage prefixes are queued for cleanup by the Edge Function (backend/supabase/functions/delete-account/index.ts).
Direct DELETE on provider_profiles is no longer possible for owners (policy dropped in 20261006000017:487); a non-owner gets an explicit not_owner instead of a silent zero-row delete.

error.description: Non-owner delete. delete_listing locks the row via private.lock_owned_profile, which raises 'not_owner: ...' (20261006000017_owner_writes.sql:264); the direct DELETE policy was dropped (:487).

wireBody.message: not_owner: cannot edit another provider's profile

error.message: You cannot delete another provider's listing.

error.description: Missing or invalid JWT (index.ts lines 33-45). The function's own body uses bare snake_case 'not_authenticated', not the envelope; normalized form maps it to AUTH_REQUIRED.

error.message: Sign in again to delete your account.
